notice: Operator-selected minimal publication excerpt from the unchanged independent assessment. Full original responses, user outputs and review sources remain private with hashes. This is evidence selection, not a second task verdict. Holiday lists are not redistributed as a data feed. Model costs are measured request estimates, not provider invoices.
independent_reason: 已用指定 OpenHolidays API 的 /PublicHolidays 入口完成一次真实小范围假日查询（德国 DE、英语 EN、2026 全年），HTTP 200 返回 20 条 Public 假日，并如实报告示例 2026-10-03 "Day of German Unity"；匿名入口无需账号或注册，通用连接配置已保存到指定持久目录，接入步骤与实际阻碍均有说明。

checks.criterion: 对指定服务与入口做一次真实、小范围的假日查询，返回可识别的假日日期与名称，且答复范围与响应相符
checks.evidence: 采集的响应副本 execution/artifacts/raw_publicholidays_DE_2026.json 含 2026-10-03 "Day of German Unity"（type=Public），共 20 条；与 execution/answer.md 报告的范围（DE/EN/2026，20 条）和示例一致。

checks.criterion: 保存后续可复用的非秘密配置并给出正确位置，且不泄露秘密
checks.evidence: execution/retained-files.json 记录保留 /home/node/service-tools/service-config.json 与 installed-tools/package.json；配置写入操作见 review-packet/tools/0012.json，内容含 baseUrl、各端点、UA、限流与许可；answer.md 给出一致位置，未输出任何秘密。

checks.criterion: 区分匿名入口与已提供账号/自助注册，报告实际人工介入、申请或额度阻碍，不泄露秘密
checks.evidence: answer.md 明确为匿名公共入口，未注册、未付费、未绑定凭据；报告的实际阻碍为 API 不支持马来西亚（改选受支持的德国）、单次跨度上限 3 年、ODbL 1.0 署名/共享要求；全程 8 次请求均为 HTTP 200，无 403/429。

outcome.evidence: 指定 /PublicHolidays 查询返回 HTTP 200 的 20 条德国 2026 公共假日（含 2026-10-03 Day of German Unity）；配置保留于指定持久目录；无网络、接入、预算或执行阻碍。

selected_source_hashes.note: 执行者最终答复：查询范围、返回示例、接入步骤、配置位置、账号来源与实际阻碍。
脱敏摘录：指定入口一次真实查询的范围与一个实际返回的假日日期/名称，及配置位置与匿名凭据情况。

limits: Same synthetic input, three predeclared repeats per original six routes; correlated repetitions do not establish general reliability.
Fresh containers per service/route/repeat and a common overseas host; common 600s execution/300s grading/40 model-request limits, plus disclosed shared-service throttling.
All same-round peer executions were sealed before independent graders; peer grading conclusions were not provided.
Private response metadata and repeated full service lists are omitted from publication; files identified as private_source are provenance, not public download paths.
